title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 621 Kansas Avenue in Atchison, Kansas, as the "Amelia Earhart Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 621 Kansas Avenue in Atchison, Kansas, as the "Amelia Earhart Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names the U.S. Postal Service building at 621 Kansas Avenue in Atchison, Kansas, the "Amelia Earhart Post Office Building."
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a specific post office in Atchison, Kansas, an official honorary name. The building at 621 Kansas Avenue is now called the Amelia Earhart Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted April 3, 2018, when it was signed into law.
